standard.label: KFD-1
standard.title: Contracts must not drift: contract worlds need one fact source

contractWorld.name: KFD standards metadata and release propagation surfaces

versionImpact.rationale: This change additively registers KFD-owned standards metadata, KFD-2 release trust schemas, KFD-3 collaboration-interface schemas, and KFD-1 document/interface integrity bindings while keeping existing registry and decision surfaces compatible.

surfaceImpacts.rationale: KFD documents are append-only content coordinates; current decision text changes do not alter a machine-consumed surface.
registry.json keeps schemaVersion 1 and the existing entry shape, including number, id, slug, title, kind, status, path, and url; slug and path values are stable number coordinates.

standards.json and schemas/ add KFD-2 release-claims and release-trust-passport schema IDs, explicit KFD-1/2/3 interface versions, KFD document SHA-256 bindings, and KFD-owned concept names for downstream consumers.

The npm package now also publishes KFD-2 schemas and KFD-2 documentation through existing schemas/, docs/, standards.json, and subpath exports while preserving existing README.md, decisions/, registry.json, and site/ paths.

recovery.rollback: Use the previous exact release tag or previous floating channel ref.
